# Test fixtures

| Folder | Source |
|---|---|
| `gitlab/` | Hand-written from GitLab REST API v4 docs (small, targeted cases). |
| `gitlab-reports/` | **Real** GitLab security reports from GitLab's analyzer images: semgrep:6 (SAST), container-scanning:8 (trimmed to 20 vulns), gemnasium:6 (dependency), secrets:7 (secret detection; input token random, report holds only a hash). |
| `gitlab-real/` | **Real** gitlab.com API responses for public pipelines (`gitlab-org/security-products/analyzers/semgrep`, `gitlab-org/cli`), collected anonymously by the `gitlab-contract` workflow. Allow-listed fields only: no user, commit author or runner data. |
| `semgrep/` | **Real** output of Semgrep 1.181.1 (`p/default`), produced by the `fixtures` workflow. |
| `sarif/` | **Real** SARIF from Semgrep 1.181.1, Trivy 0.76.1, gitleaks 8.30.1 (secret randomly generated at run time and redacted) and Checkov 3.3.30. Large logs trimmed with `scripts/trim_report.py` (results capped, unused rules removed). |
| `cyclonedx/` | **Real** CycloneDX 1.7 SBOMs from Trivy 0.76.1 and Syft 1.55.0, trimmed to 30 components. |
| `checkov/` | **Real** Checkov 3.3.30 JSON for `examples/sample-projects/terraform`. |
| `trivy/` | **Real** output of Trivy 0.76.1. `trivy-python.json` was trimmed with `scripts/trim_trivy_report.py` (package list removed, 10 vulns per result kept; original counts recorded under `_scanproof_fixture`). |
| `fortify/` | **Real** FPR produced by Fortify SCA 24.2.0, from [DefectDojo](https://github.com/DefectDojo/django-DefectDojo)'s test suite (`unittests/scans/fortify/hello_world.fpr`). |
| `sonatype/` | **Real** Sonatype IQ raw application reports from DefectDojo's test suite (`unittests/scans/sonatype/`). |

## Regenerating scanner fixtures

Fixtures are generated by the live workflows in [scanproof-e2e](https://github.com/abdelrahman-eladwy/scanproof-e2e). Older files were produced
when those workflows lived here, so they record paths such as `examples/sample-projects/...` and
run URLs of this repository; that is expected.

1. Push any commit to a branch of scanproof-e2e named `fixtures/scanners/<something>`; its
   `fixtures` workflow runs and commits its outputs to that branch under `generated-fixtures/`.
2. Review the files, trim large Trivy reports, copy them here, and update the versions above
   and the expected values in `tests/unit/test_scanners.py`.
3. Delete the branch. (Real GitLab API fixtures: same flow with `fixtures/gitlab/<something>`.)

## snyk/

`snyk test --json` outputs (single project, all projects, container) from DefectDojo's unit-test
data (commit fc97a744, BSD-3-Clause, see `LICENSE-DefectDojo.md`): Snyk needs an account to run,
so its fixtures are not generated here.

## gitleaks/, grype/, osv/, kubescape/, zap/, nuclei/

Generated by the `scanners-v2` job of the `fixtures` workflow (gitleaks v8.30.1 with a
random fake token and `--redact`; grype 0.121.0 on pinned alpine and python:3.12-slim, the latter
trimmed to 30 matches; osv-scanner 2.7.0 on `examples/sample-projects/node`; kubescape v3.0.46
on `examples/sample-projects/kubernetes`; ZAP 2.17.0 baseline and Nuclei v3.11.1 against a local
nginx container). `nuclei-empty-export.json` is what `-je` writes when nothing is found.

## Real Azure DevOps, Jenkins and Bitbucket API responses

Collected by the `platforms-contract` workflow (run 40463320446) with its
`scripts/collect_{azure_devops,jenkins,bitbucket}.py`. Only whitelisted fields are kept: no
people (requestedBy/For, creators, authors), avatars, logs or commit messages.

- `azure-real/` - anonymous reads of the public projects `dnceng-public/public` (dotnet) and
  `azure-sdk/public`: build, timeline (and `timeline-<id>.json` for earlier attempts of re-run
  jobs) and artifact listings. Builds: partially succeeded (tasks failed under continueOnError),
  succeeded, and one with a re-run job.
- `jenkins-real/` - a throwaway Jenkins 2.580.1 (scanproof-e2e `jenkins/`) running one pipeline per masking
  pattern: `api/json`, Pipeline Graph View (`stages/tree`, `stages/allSteps`) and Stage View
  (`wfapi`) responses. The only user is the throwaway `scanproof` account.
- `bitbucket-real/` - anonymous reads of public Atlassian pipe repositories: pipelines, steps,
  and Code Insights reports with annotations (`report-<uuid>[-annotations].json`).
